info.title: SmartInvoice AI API
info.description: Contract milestone; runtime not yet implemented. Auth sign-up/sign-in uses Supabase Auth directly.

post.summary: Create receipt and signed upload ticket
post.description: Same user/key and payload returns the same receipt. A replay may mint a fresh ticket only while awaiting_upload; record maximum ticket expiry before responding. After submit upload=null. 5 MB = 5,000,000 bytes. Use Supabase uploadToSignedUrl(path, token, file), upsert=false.

post.summary: Verify uploaded file and enqueue OCR
post.description: Locks receipt, validates actual bytes and file signature, stores SHA-256, inserts one durable database job and outbox event. Repeated submit returns existing job. A server-side dispatcher invokes the configured RunPod worker.
